concept_patches.new_text: Payment Request Button → ECE migration: [[source-stripe-express-checkout-element-migration]] preserves the Payment Intents steps captured on 2026-04-21 and identifies the Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents variant routes in Stripe's 2026-11-07 index. The index does not establish either variant's current implementation details.
concept_patches.reason: The old full guide is historical Payment Intents evidence; the new canonical capture is only a two-variant index, so the unqualified 'Full migration guide' route misstates the current capture.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/elements/express-checkout-element/migration, the source [[source-stripe-express-checkout-element-migration]] now clearly dates the retained Payment Intents migration steps to the 2026-04-21 guide (OLD raw lines 10–13, 21–27, 429–439 and 567–579). The 2026-11-07 capture is only a variant index (NEW raw lines 9–14), so it cannot validate current steps or establish deprecation.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/elements/express-checkout-element/migration, [[source-stripe-express-checkout-element-migration]] now qualifies the `automatic_payment_methods` comment as the 2026-04-21 guide's latest-API-version claim (OLD raw line 135). The 2026-11-07 index supplies separate Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents routes (NEW raw lines 11–14), but no variant bodies, API-default proof, or Checkout Sessions implementation steps.
